theorems.statement: ∀ (d : ℕ) (ρ : Measure (Fin d → ℝ)), IsFiniteMeasure ρ → ∀ β : ℝ, 0 < β → volume {g : Fin d → ℝ | (∀ k, |g k - 1 / 2| < 1 / 4) ∧ ∃ r : ℝ, 0 < r ∧ r ≤ 1 / 4 ∧ ENNReal.ofReal (β * r ^ d) * ρ univ < ρ {y | ∃ z : Fin d → ℤ, ∑ k, (y k - g k - z k) ^ 2 < r ^ 2}} ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (10 ^ d / β)
